record.paper_title: Several Open Problems on Banach Spaces (Castro Urdiales 2014)
record.original_question: For every Banach space X, does K(X**) = K(X), where X** is the bidual and K(X) is the supremum of all sigma > 0 for which the unit ball B_X contains a sequence (x_n) with ||x_n - x_m|| >= sigma whenever n != m?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a Banach space $X$, let $B_X = \{x \in X : \|x\| \le 1\}$ denote its closed unit ball, and define the Kottman constant of $X$ by
$$K(X) = \sup\{\sigma > 0 : \text{there exists a sequence } (x_n)_{n \ge 1} \subset B_X \text{ with } \|x_n - x_m\| \ge \sigma \text{ for all } n \ne m\}.$$
Let $X^{**}$ denote the bidual of $X$, equipped with its canonical norm. Determine whether the equality
$$K(X^{**}) = K(X)$$
holds for every infinite-dimensional Banach space $X$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches turned up recent work on the Kottman constant (e.g., isomorphic Kottman constant, Hölder-Kottman constants, symmetric separation, the inequality $K(X)\cdot K(X^*) \ge 2$), but no source explicitly resolving whether $K(X^{**}) = K(X)$ for every Banach space. The problem appears to remain unresolved in the literature available, but this could not be confirmed with certainty.

status_evidence.title: The isomorphic Kottman constant of a Banach space
status_evidence.snippet: K(X)·K(X*) ≥ 2 for every infinite-dimensional Banach space X.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on Kottman constants involving duals are known, but equality with the bidual is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: The Kottman constant for α-Hölder maps
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Hölder variants of the Kottman constant.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to develop the theory of Kottman constants without settling the bidual question.

status_evidence.title: A note on symmetric separation in Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses separated sequences in unit balls.
status_evidence.claim: Related separation problems are actively studied.
